cases.title: Substantial implementation

files.requirements.md: Build a local Python CSV export module using the standard library. It must retain name/status column order, quote commas/newlines correctly, reject malformed rows with a clear error, and include runnable tests. No external services.

cases.prompt: Implement the export module described in requirements.md and carry it through to verification.

cases.title: Diagnosis across layers

files.service.py:
def open_rows(rows):
    return [row for row in rows if row['done']]

cases.prompt: The dashboard shows completed tasks in the open list and the count does not agree. Diagnose the flow across these files, fix it, and add a meaningful regression check.

cases.title: Substantial constrained research

files.brief.md: One-user local notes app, possibly a small team later. Linux host, no hosted accounts, reliable backup and recovery required.

cases.prompt: Research SQLite versus PostgreSQL for brief.md. Use current official sources, explain operational and backup tradeoffs, and produce a practical recommendation. Do not install either database.
